assumptions.basis: Paper Table I bandwidth/capacity and 1800/100 GB/s fabrics; current NVIDIA HGX Rubin dense BF16 4 PFLOPS and FP32 130 TFLOPS supplement undisclosed paper compute. Author SAFARI talk slide 19 explicitly assumes specified peak performance for GPU cores, memory and interconnects; matrix/scalar efficiencies are therefore 100%. 500 ns launch/link startup, 10 TB/s SRAM per stack, 1 ns SRAM, dedicated per-GPU NICs, uniform expert routing and balanced striped buffers are research assumptions, not paper measurements. No paper throughput is fitted.

precision.basis: Explicit BF16 research choice; not a dtype reported by the paper.

selection_scope: all discrete layouts screened; best of bounded closed-loop validations, not a proved global optimum
